## Summary

Describe the observed defect and affected component.

## Version and environment

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest deterministic steps and synthetic input needed to

## Expected behavior

What should have happened?

## Actual behavior

What happened instead? Include sanitized exception types and timestamps where

## Verification attempted

List tests, workarounds, or runbooks already tried.

## Security and privacy checklist

- [ ] This is not a vulnerability report.
- [ ] No API keys, passwords, JWTs, production data, raw prompts, generated
      text, or personal information are included.

Report vulnerabilities privately using `SECURITY_CONTACT.md`.
